subject: Combining accelerator stipends with Redwood onboarding voucher — exception request
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@elevateaccelerator.org>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on stacking accelerator stipends + Redwood voucher

Hi Avery,

Hope youre well — thanks again for the demo last month. Were finalizing the benefits package for the upcoming cohort at Elevate Accelerator and had one quick eligibility question.

Normally we provide each startup a $5k stipend (for cloud credits) that they can apply to any vendor. A few founders have asked whether that stipend can be used together with vendor-provided onboarding vouchers. Specifically: can we allow startups to apply the Elevate stipend and also redeem Redwoods onboarding voucher (the $2k trial voucher for new teams) on the same account?

From a legal/vendor perspective, wed like to confirm:
- Is Redwoods onboarding voucher combinable with third-party program credits?
- If not fully combinable, can we allow a partial stack (e.g., stipend applies to paid usage above voucher limits)?

Were trying to avoid creating extra invoice/PO friction for founders while keeping the program sustainable. Attached is a short doc describing our benefits stack.

Could you loop in whoever needs to weigh in on billing/finance and contract terms? Were hoping to publish the program page this week.

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Program Director, Elevate Accelerator
(e) samir@elevateaccelerator.org
(t) +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: elevate_program_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@elevateaccelerator.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on stacking accelerator stipends + Redwood voucher

Hey Samir — great to hear from you and congrats on the new cohort. Short answer: weve historically preferred that vendor vouchers not be trivially stackable with third-party stipends because of accounting and promo misuse, but were open to a narrowly scoped exception for trusted accelerator partners.

A few things I want to confirm so were aligned:
- Is the Elevate stipend credited directly on the startups cloud billing account (i.e., a 3rd-party credit applied by Elevate), or do you hand founders a coupon code to redeem?
- Do you expect all cohort companies to use the stipend up front, or will some save it for later usage (affects expiry alignment)?
- Are you asking for an explicit policy statement we can publish on the program page, or an account-level exception (MSA/PO amendment) per cohort?

Ill loop Ben (sales lead for partners) for commercial terms and Laura for the finance/accounting constraints. If it helps, we can propose a simple hybrid model: allow the stipend to be applied after the onboarding voucher is consumed (voucher first, stipend second) and limit stacking to a single cohort redemption per company. That avoids doubling initial free-tier consumption while letting founders maximize runway.

Next steps: Ben/Laura — can you weigh in on viability + any required contract changes? Samir, if you can share whether stipend delivery is code-based vs. vendor-applied credit thats very helpful.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@elevateaccelerator.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on stacking accelerator stipends + Redwood voucher

Thanks for flagging this, Avery/Samir. I like the hybrid-first approach — keeps the program simple. Practical considerations from sales/ops:

- If Elevate issues a coupon code founders redeem on signup, we can detect and prevent double-redemption server-side and allow a post-voucher stipend application. Thats engineerable and low-risk.
- If Elevates stipend is a direct credit applied by you to an account, well need a short MOA (scope: cohort id, one-time stipend per company, expiry alignment) to prevent accounting surprises.
- For public program language: we should say \"Eligible cohort companies may combine the Elevate stipend with Redwood's onboarding voucher; stipend applies after Redwood voucher is consumed, terms apply.\"

Id propose the following commercial carve-outs:
1) Stack limited to one-time per-company during the first 12 months of account creation.
2) Credits apply only to pay-as-you-go usage (not to any previously committed reserved capacity).
3) We reserve the right to deny stacking in abuse cases.

I attached a draft that templates the terms so we can spin an MOU quickly. If youre OK, Laura, can finance approve the principle and suggest any bookkeeping language we need?

Attachment: proposed-hybrid-voucher-terms.docx (docx)

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@elevateaccelerator.org>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on stacking accelerator stipends + Redwood voucher

Quick finance note / approval in principle.

We can approve a controlled stacking exception under these conditions:
- Stipend must be delivered via a single-use coupon code that maps to an internal cohort ID (so we can reconcile).
- Coupon must expire 90 days after issuance; voucher expiry must be documented and aligned (we prefer voucher first, coupon second).
- Credits are non-refundable and should be recorded as promotional contra-revenue; Elevate must provide a signed cohort roster monthly for reconciliation (name + company email).
- Any company that redeems >$10k combined value across promotions in the first 30 days will trigger a manual review.

If Elevate is comfortable with those items, we can sign a one-page MOU and update our partner page wording. Ben/Avery — operationally well need the cohort ID scheme, sample coupon format, and an SFTP or Drive location to ingest rosters.

Laura Bennett
Finance — Partnerships & Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir@elevateaccelerator.org>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on stacking accelerator stipends + Redwood voucher

This is perfect — thanks everyone. We deliver the stipend as a single-use coupon code tied to a cohort code (we already have that flow for other vendors). 90-day expiry and a monthly roster export works for us.

Next steps from our side:
- Ill share the cohort coupon format and the pilot roster (first 12 companies) by EOD Thursday.
- Please send the one-page MOU and the partner page blurb for legal review.

If it helps, wed like the blurb to say something like: \"Elevate cohort companies may stack an Elevate stipend with Redwood onboarding vouchers; stipend applies after voucher redemption. Terms and reconciliation requirements apply.\"

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to finalize language.

Best,
Samir
